title: Rachana Data Protocol v1: error body and error frame
description: The body of every HTTP error and the err frame of a stream (PROTOCOL.md section 10). Messages never include row values.

code.description: One of the codes above; a host may send others of its own in the rdp. family, which a reader treats as rdp.internal.

rch.description: Optional: the RCH code the runtime reports for this failure (section 10.2).

errFrame.description: The events protocol's err frame carrying a Data Protocol code.
